gloss: to replace; to swap; to exchange

definitions.gloss: to replace; to swap; to exchange
definitions.explanation: to remove one thing and put another in its place; to switch positions

examples.japanese: {電池|でんち}を{入|い}れ{替|か}えた。
{順番|じゅんばん}を{入|い}れ{替|か}える。
{冬服|ふゆふく}と{夏服|なつふく}を{入|い}れ{替|か}えた。
examples.english: I swapped out my winter and summer clothes.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive ({他動詞|たどうし})
Intransitive pair: {入|い}れ{替|か}わる (to be replaced, to change places)

USAGE:
- 〜を{入|い}れ{替|か}える (to replace/swap ~)
- AとBを{入|い}れ{替|か}える (to swap A and B)

COMMON CONTEXTS:
- {電池|でんち}を{入|い}れ{替|か}える (replace batteries)
- {選手|せんしゅ}を{入|い}れ{替|か}える (substitute players)
- {順番|じゅんばん}を{入|い}れ{替|か}える (change order)
- {衣替|ころもが}え (seasonal clothing change)

RELATED:
- {入|い}れ{替|か}わる (intransitive: to switch places)
- {取|と}り{替|か}える (to exchange)
- {置|お}き{換|か}える (to replace, substitute)
